text:
Alex: Morning team — quick async check (what I did / blockers / today)

Alex: What I did: landed prefetch microtune PR (#4890), added tighter backpressure for micro-batches, and fixed a small slot allocator race.
Alex: Blockers: seeing KV eviction spikes on the canary when concurrency hits ~62k reqs/s — need to verify eviction thresholds.
Alex: Today: watch canary, roll a patch if spike repros, run a focused p95/p99 perf sweep.

Mira: Nice. quick q — which canary cluster is that? I thought dedicated-3 was stable.

Alex: It's dedicated-canary-7 (small pool with mixed gpus). Sam started the rollout last night.

Sam: Sam: Yup — started canary @ 02:10 UTC. initial metrics looked fine until ~03:40, then KV eviction rate jumped. I scaled pool by 1 node to see if it's load-related.

Chloe: Chloe: I pulled the trace for the spike — looks like a pattern of many short-lived contexts causing hot-set churn. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/evict/7 (screenshot pinned)

Jon: Jon: ran a quick microbench locally against the branch. results below:
```
# local perf (devbox A100)
batch=1 seq=1024
p50: 14.6ms
p95: 39.2ms
p99: 91.5ms
cpu-util: 62%
```
Jon: After toggling the new backpressure to aggressive, p99 dropped ~12ms in repeat runs.

Mira: Mira: Could be that eviction threshold needs to be bumped for the canary. I can assemble a small test that simulates short contexts to reproduce.

Alex: Good plan. If Mira can reproduce, we'll try two things: (1) bump in-memory threshold on canary, (2) toggle the new kv-prefetch gating to reduce thrash.

perf-bot: perf-bot: Automated run complete — artifact: s3://redwood-perf/1745550000/prefetch-microtune-4890.tar.gz; summary: p95 improved 8% on average across tested models.

Chloe: Chloe: Also noticed a tiny mem-leak at ~1.8GB over 12h in the canary logs — adding a pointer to the heaptrace in the PR.

Sam: Sam: I'll keep canary at +1 node and enable extended logging for 6h. If we hit the same spike, I'll roll back the patch.

Jon: Jon: FYI I left a comment on PR #4890 about a potential NPE in the fallback path when kv misses are frequent.

Alex: Alex: Thanks — can everyone please: (a) react with :thumbsup: once you've read, (b) drop any urgent asks here.

Mira: Mira: 👍 I'll get the repro script by EOD.

Chloe: Chloe: 👍 pinning heaptrace and dashboard links to the PR now.

Sam: Sam: 👍 keeping an eye on canary, will post if it regresses.

Jon: Jon: 👍 will follow up on the PR comment and re-run the bench after Mira's repro.

Alex: Alex: Great — wrapping. If anything critical, ping me @alex or escalate in #incidents. Thanks all :rocket:
